{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "FULL WEBSITE BRIEF – GreenVow Wedding Collective (static Astro site only)

Create a clean, elegant marketing website for an eco-friendly wedding planning studio called GreenVow. The brand helps couples plan beautiful low-waste weddings using sustainable flowers, recycled paper goods, local food, rented decor, ethical venues, and carbon-conscious travel ideas. The website must feel modern, calm, premium, romantic, and environmentally responsible — not childish, not too rustic, not corporate.

TECH / DELIVERY
- Build as a static website using Astro.
- No backend, no database, no login, no CMS, no real APIs.
- All content can be mock/static/sample content inside the project.
- Forms can be visual only, or show a simple front-end success message without sending anywhere.
- Must be responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
- Include a working dark mode toggle with saved preference in localStorage.
- Keep everything clean and lightweight.

STYLE DIRECTION
- Overall vibe: clean editorial wedding magazine + sustainable lifestyle brand.
- Visual reference: Twitter/X style simplicity for layout clarity — generous whitespace, crisp cards, simple navigation, clean readable typography, subtle borders, rounded panels, minimal clutter. Do NOT copy Twitter branding, only the clean feed/card/navigation feeling.
- Color palette light mode: warm ivory, sage green, eucalyptus, clay beige, charcoal text.
- Dark mode: deep forest, dark charcoal, muted sage, warm cream text, subtle glowing accents.
- Typography: elegant serif for hero headlines, modern sans-serif for body/navigation.
- Use soft gradients, botanical line icons, recycled paper texture 느낌 optional but very subtle.
- Imagery can be placeholder gradients/cards with descriptive alt text if real images are not available.

SITE STRUCTURE
1. Header
- Sticky top navigation.
- Logo text: GreenVow.
- Nav links: Services, Process, Packages, Gallery, Sustainability, Testimonials, FAQ.
- CTA button: Plan a Low-Waste Wedding.
- Dark mode toggle visible in header, icon changes sun/moon.
- Mobile hamburger menu.

2. Hero Section
Headline: Weddings with beauty, meaning, and a lighter footprint.
Subheadline: GreenVow designs elegant celebrations that reduce waste without sacrificing style, comfort, or emotion.
CTA buttons: Start Planning / View Packages.
Add a small trust line: Planned with local vendors • Plastic-free details • Thoughtful guest experience.
Right side hero visual: clean card stack showing wedding checklist, carbon-conscious choices, floral moodboard, venue note.
Include small floating labels like “Reusable Decor”, “Seasonal Florals”, “Digital Invites”.

3. Social Proof / Stats Strip
Use clean cards similar to simple social feed metrics.
Stats examples:
- 42 sample celebrations planned
- 68% average decor reuse rate
- 1200+ single-use items avoided
- 4.9/5 couple satisfaction
Make clear these are sample/demo numbers.

4. Services Section
Grid of service cards:
- Full-Service Sustainable Planning
- Eco Venue Shortlisting
- Low-Waste Floral Styling
- Conscious Catering Guidance
- Digital Invitation Suite
- Guest Travel & Welcome Planning
Each card: title, short description, small icon, hover effect.

5. Process Section
Timeline with 5 steps:
1 Discover your values
2 Build your wedding footprint plan
3 Curate vendors and materials
4 Design the celebration experience
5 Celebrate, reuse, donate, compost
Use clean numbered pills and horizontal/vertical responsive layout.

6. Packages Section
Three pricing/package cards, static content:
- Seedling Consultation – for couples starting early
- Evergreen Planning – most popular full support
- Canopy Celebration – premium destination/weekend wedding support
Do not need real checkout. CTA buttons just link to contact section.
Include feature lists, soft highlight on middle plan, clean badge “Most loved”.

7. Gallery / Inspiration Section
Editorial masonry or grid with static cards, not real image API.
Categories: Forest Ceremony, Garden Dinner, Recycled Paper Suite, Candlelit Reception, Seasonal Bouquet, Reusable Tablescape.
Use placeholder image blocks with gradients and captions if needed.
Add hover overlay with short sustainability note.

8. Sustainability Impact Section
This is important. Create a calm educational block that explains how the studio reduces environmental impact:
- Rent before buying
- Choose seasonal local flowers
- Replace disposable signage
- Donate or compost leftovers
- Digital-first communication
- Support ethical local vendors
Include an “Impact Snapshot” card with mock numbers and progress bars.

9. Testimonial Section
Use a Twitter-inspired clean testimonial feed layout: simple rounded cards, avatar circles, couple names, short quote, wedding location/date. No real Twitter embed or API.
Example names can be fictional: Maya & Theo, Lina & Jasper, Amara & Jules.
Cards should feel like social posts but original design.

10. FAQ Section
Accordion-style FAQ using front-end JavaScript only.
Questions:
- Can a sustainable wedding still feel luxurious?
- Do you work with our existing vendors?
- Is this only for outdoor weddings?
- Can you help reduce waste on a small budget?
- Do you plan destination weddings?
- What happens to flowers and decor after the event?

11. Contact / Inquiry Section
Static visual form with fields:
- Couple names
- Wedding date
- City / venue idea
- Guest count
- Sustainability priorities dropdown
- Message
Button: Send Inquiry
No backend. On submit, show a friendly static success message like “Thanks — this demo form does not send data, but your inquiry style is ready.”
Also include email text placeholder: hello@greenvow.example.

12. Footer
- Logo + short mission statement.
- Links repeated.
- Small newsletter style input visual only.
- Social links as plain text: Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok.
- Copyright 2026 GreenVow Studio.
- Add note: Static demo website.

INTERACTIONS
- Dark mode toggle with smooth transition and localStorage.
- FAQ accordion.
- Mobile menu.
- Smooth scrolling anchor links.
- Subtle hover effects on cards/buttons.
- Optional small reveal-on-scroll using CSS/JS, but keep it simple and performant.

ACCESSIBILITY / QUALITY
- Semantic HTML sections.
- Good color contrast in both modes.
- Keyboard focus states.
- Buttons and form controls accessible.
- Alt text for visual placeholders.
- No external API calls.
- No auth, accounts, dashboard, admin, database, or server logic.

Please create the Astro project files/components/styles needed for this static marketing site. Keep the code organized, clean, and easy to modify.",

  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
